# hivelocity_dns_record_ptr (Resource)

Sets the reverse DNS (PTR) name of one of your IP addresses. PTR records exist for the lifetime of the IP assignment and cannot be created or deleted through the API, so this resource adopts the existing record (look its ID up with the `hivelocity_dns_record_ptr` data source) and destroying it leaves the current name in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# PTR records already exist for your IPs; look the record up by address
# and manage its name.
data "hivelocity_dns_record_ptr" "web" {
  filter {
    name   = "address"
    values = ["66.165.231.122"]
  }
}

resource "hivelocity_dns_record_ptr" "web" {
  record_id = data.hivelocity_dns_record_ptr.web.record_id
  name      = "web.example.com"
  ttl       = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Host name the IP address resolves to.
- `record_id` (Number) ID of the PTR record.

### Optional

- `ttl` (Number) Time to live of the record, in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address of the record.
- `disabled` (Boolean) True when the record is disabled.
- `domain_id` (Number) ID of the reverse zone the record belongs to.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `type` (String) Record type as reported by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the PTR record ID
terraform import hivelocity_dns_record_ptr.web 9876
```
